title.zh: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
title.en: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s

current_state.zh: A Hacker News thread discusses running the 125B Qwen 3.8 Flash Next model on consumer hardware via the open-source Strata tool, with users reporting ~124 tok/s on an RTX 4090 and comparing alternative local-inference stacks.
